fullContentHtml:
The Bihar Technical Service Commission has announced the Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 on 14th January 2026. The results have been updated in the form of an online scorecard. All those candidates who appeared for the examination to fill out a total of 498 vacancies for the post of nursing tutors can now check and download their results by simply logging in to the official website at btsc.bihar.gov.in using their respective application no./login ID and password as login credentials. To make it easier, we have also shared a direct link for the BTSC Nursing Tutor Result in the article below. Scroll down the page for more updates regarding the tutor result PDF. 

Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 OUT

The Bihar Nursing Tutor Recruitment Exam is conducted by the Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) to select eligible candidates for the post of Nursing Tutors at various government nursing institutions across Bihar. This exam is generally held to recruit skilled teachers who can train nursing students and improve healthcare education in the state. As per the schedule, the written examination was successfully conducted on 22nd August, 2025.

Thousands of candidates appeared to get a secure government job in the nursing education field. Now, the long wait of the candidates is over with the announcement of the BTSC Nursing Tutor result on 14th January, 2026. It is to be noted that only those candidates who have successfully qualified are considered to be eligible to move to the next stage of the selection process.

BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025 – Overview

After the successful completion of the evaluation process, the Bihar Technical Service Commission has now released the BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025 at its official website. After downloading the online results, make sure you go through all the details mentioned on it. For more updates regarding the results, check the table below:

BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025 – Overview
Name of Examination  Bihar Nursing Tutor Recruitment Examination 2026
Purpose To recruit candidates for the post of Tutor (Nursing)
Conducting Body Bihar Technical Service Commission
Vacancies 498
Category Result
Status Announced
Bihar Nursing Tutor Exam Date 2025  22nd August, 2025
Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 14th January 2026
Mode of Availability Online mode
Login credentials required Application No./Login ID and password
Official website @btsc.bihar.gov.in

Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 PDF Download Link 

The official Bihar Nursing Tutor Result PDF has been updated at the official website of the Bihar Technical Service Commission on 14th January 2026. Candidates can now check and download their online results either through the official website btsc.bihar.gov.in or by simply clicking on the direct link shared in the article below. To access the BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2026, candidates are required to enter their respective application number/login ID and password as login credentials. 

Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 OUT: Click to Check

Steps to Check Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 at btsc.bihar.gov.in 

Step 1: Visit the official website of the Bihar Technical Service Commission, i.e., btsc.bihar.gov.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, look for the latest updates section.

Step 3: Now click on the “BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2026” link.

Step 4: Carefully enter your respective login credentials, such as your application no./login ID and password.

Step 5: Once all the details are successfully filled, click on the submit button.

Step 6: A new page with the detailed Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2026 PDF will be displayed on the screen.

Step 7: At the end, check and download the complete result PDF for further use. 

What Details are Mentioned on the BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025

The online Bihar Nursing Tutor results consist of all the necessary details that a candidate must know. Some of them have also been shared below: 

  • Candidate’s Name 
  • Date of Birth
  • Roll Number 
  • Registration Number 
  • Post Name
  • Category
  • Marks Obtained 
  • Section-wise Marks
  • Qualifying Status / Result Status 
  • Cut-off Marks 
  • Merit Rank/Position 
  • Date of Result Declaration 
  • Instructions/Remarks

BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025: FAQs

Q1. Is the Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 Announced?

Answer: Yes, the Bihar Nursing Tutor Result 2025 has been released by the Bihar Technical Service Commission on 14 January 2026.

Q2. Where can I check and download the BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025?

Answer: To check and download the online BTSC Nursing Tutor Result 2025, candidates are required to visit the official website btsc.bihar.gov.in and log in using their respective login credentials. 

Q3. What login credentials are required to access the Bihar Nursing Tutor 2025 Results?

Answer: Candidates are required to enter their respective application no./login ID and password as login credentials to access their online BTSC Nursing Tutor results.

Q4. How many vacancies are there for the post of Bihar Nursing Tutor?

Answer: For the year 2025, there are a total of 498 vacancies for the post of Bihar Nursing Tutor.
